title: Impact of serous macular detachment on visual recovery in retinal vein occlusion treatment

exclusions.what: Table 3 VA (logMAR) at the initial visit and months 3, 6, 9 and 12 for BRVO and CRVO by serous macular detachment status (t3)
exclusions.reason: Protocol inclusion 1: the rows are 'VA' and the Methods never state that the acuity reported is best-corrected (ETDRS is named only as the scale of a retreatment criterion), so the acuity is not admissible

exclusions.what: Results-text initial and final VA by RVO type, macular ischemia and ELM status
exclusions.reason: Same inclusion-1 reason; also text rather than table cells, and the final visit is undated
Baseline only, or not visual acuity

notes: Treatment context recorded as 'other': eyes received an intravitreal dexamethasone implant and/or bevacizumab, ranibizumab or aflibercept, including anti-VEGF added after a poor response to dexamethasone; no arm is defined by one treatment.
Retrospective chart review; inclusion required the first visit and at least one of the 3-, 6-, 9- and 12-month visits.
